questions.prompt: Which conflict involved the Battle of Gettysburg?
questions.fact: It was the war's bloodiest battle and its turning point. Lincoln's address there four months later ran barely two minutes.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern?
questions.fact: The stars in one are rarely near each other in space; they only appear grouped from our particular vantage point.

questions.prompt: What is the diameter of a basketball hoop, in inches?
questions.fact: Two balls can fit through it side by side, with only a little room to spare.

questions.prompt: Which South Korean survival drama became Netflix's most-watched launch in 2021?
questions.fact: Its production budget was modest by prestige-television standards, and the show had been shopped around for roughly a decade.

questions.prompt: Which country's flag features a red maple leaf?
questions.fact: The design was adopted only in 1965, after a parliamentary debate so bitter it ran for months.

questions.prompt: Which novel begins 'All happy families are alike'?
questions.fact: The author rewrote the opening dozens of times, and his wife is said to have copied the manuscript by hand repeatedly.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the first mass-market graphical spreadsheet for Windows?
questions.fact: Its spreadsheet was released for the Macintosh first, two years before the Windows version arrived.
